clips.title: The story
paras: Perched in the northeastern hills of Tirisfal Glades, the Scarlet Monastery was once a peaceful sanctuary and center of learning for the Church of the Holy Light. Following the fall of Lordaeron, it was seized and heavily fortified by the Scarlet Crusade as their primary forward base in the west. Now, it stands as a sprawling stronghold divided into four wings, where fanatical zealots train, torture captives, and wage an uncompromising war against all outsiders.

Before the Third War, the monastery served as a proud seat of Lordaeron's priesthood and a center for learning and enlightenment. Following the Scourge's devastation, surviving crusaders purged the halls of lingering undead and spiders, transforming the tranquil archives and courtyards into a fortified garrison. Driven by paranoia and grief, the Scarlet Crusade came to view all outsiders—living or undead, human or otherwise—as carriers of the plague who must be cleansed with fire.

Past the monastery's Grand Vestibule lie four distinct quarters. The Graveyard is an unhallowed open-air terrace where fallen crusaders rise as undead abominations and torturers pry confessions from prisoners. The Library preserves precious theological texts and historical tomes, guarded by the renegade mage Arcanist Doan and his hounds. The Armory serves as a training ground where Scarlet weaponmasters like Herod drill fanatic recruits into ironclad warriors. Deepest within stands the Cathedral, the grand heart of the stronghold where the Crusade's leadership directs their crusade across the blighted north.
